column3: “High places of antiquity” is rendered “everlasting heights.”
“Because by cause” is rendered “For good cause,” and “crush” follows a rare word.
“Lift up my hand” is rendered “I have sworn.”
“They have brought near to come” is rendered “they will soon come.”
“Nations your” follows the written text; the reading tradition has “your nation.”
“Bereave” follows the reading tradition; the written text has “cause to stumble.”
“Showed pity on” is rendered “had concern for.”
“Bring about this” is rendered “cause you to walk.”
